content.short: Give the people the power to exchange every CNT using ada handles in a single transaction.
content.description: $handles.exchange is a new way of exchanging based on the use of ada handles to make it easier for anyone to use and access the blockchain securely using the Cardano L1. A single transaction is all it takes to carry out any token exchange.
content.meta: Find out about $handles.exchange ($Handles) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions. Get immediate access to the project Website, Social Media, Whitepaper...
